name: The Harwood Arms

menus.name: Three-course menu
menus.note: Lunch or dinner, a choice of about four dishes at each course, changing daily; a vegetarian menu on request. Snacks such as the venison Scotch egg are £8–12 extra

menus.name: Two-course menu
menus.note: The same menu, two courses, lunch or dinner

menus.name: Sunday menu
menus.note: All day Sunday, with roasts for two to share as the main course; two courses £64. Jersey beef sirloin is £7.50 a person extra

bookingOpens: Online through OpenTable, up to 90 days ahead. Card details are needed to secure every booking.
cancellation: No-shows and cancellations within 24 hours of the booking are charged £50 a person, including for bookings made at short notice.
groups: The largest table is for eight.
duration: Guests with a 9.15pm booking who arrive after 9.30pm can order only two courses, and the table may not be kept after 9.45pm.
byob: One 75cl bottle per person, at £40 corkage a bottle; corkage is free at Friday lunch, except in December.
photoAlt: The Harwood Arms pub on Walham Grove, Fulham, London
